
======== [G] Second-order spec table: %OS = 100 exp(-zeta pi / sqrt(1-zeta^2))
zeta=0.2: 52.7%  zeta=0.25: 44.4%  zeta=0.3: 37.2%  zeta=0.4: 25.4%  zeta=0.5: 16.3%  zeta=0.6:  9.5%  zeta=0.7:  4.6%  zeta=0.8:  1.5%  zeta=1:  0.0%
Ts = 4/(zeta wn) (LN1 slide 59), Tr1 = (2.16 zeta + 0.6)/wn for 0.3<=zeta<=0.8 (slide 60), Tp = pi/wd

======== [H1] House model (sceneLsModels HOUSE): physics -> ODE -> G(s)
b = 3600/C_th = 0.0036 K/h per W; between-room conductance = C_th*1/h = 277.8 W/K; leak to outdoors = C_th*0.2/h = 55.6 W/K per room
room 1: x1' = -1.2 x1 + x2 + b u ;  room 2: x2' = x1 - 1.2 x2
eliminate x1:  x2'' + 2.4 x2' + 0.44 x2 = b u   (check: det(sI-A) = [1.   2.4  0.44] )
eig(A) = [-2.2 -0.2] 1/h -> time constants 5.0 h and 27.27272727272727 min (average mode, difference mode)
G2(s) = X2/U = 0.0036/(s^2+2.4s+0.44) = 0.0036/((s+0.2)(s+2.2)); DC gain = 0.008182 K/W = 8.182 K per kW
G1(s) = X1/U = 0.0036(s+1.2)/((s+0.2)(s+2.2)): zero at -1.2 between the poles; DC 0.009818 K/W
2.5 kW steady state: room 1 24.55 K, room 2 20.45 K above outdoor -> 29.5 C / 25.5 C at 5 C outside
power to hold room 2 at 15 K above outdoor (20 C): 1833 W; at 13 K (18 C): 1589 W
both poles real and negative -> step response can never overshoot (open loop)

======== [H2] House step: 2.5 kW heater switched on, room 2
partial fractions: x2(t) = 20.4545 -22.5000 e^(-0.2t) +2.0455 e^(-2.2t)  (sum of residues -1.3e-15)
x2(1 h) = 2.260 K, x2(5 h) = 12.177 K (59.5 % of final), x2(10 h) = 17.410 K
metrics: final=20.45, peak=20.45, OS=0, Tp=60, Ts=20.04, Tr1090=11.06
first-order stand-in (keep DC gain, drop -2.2): 20.45(1-e^(-t/5)): max gap 1.463 K; its Ts = 4*5 = 20 h
room 1 metrics (zero at -1.2, still no overshoot): final=24.55, peak=24.55, OS=0, Tp=60, Ts=19.13, Tr1090=10.75

======== [H3] House model reduction (frequency matching, LN2 31-33) and dominance ratio
pole ratio 2.2/0.2 = 11.0 (> 5-10x rule) -> dominant pole -0.2 /h
G2 = 0.00818/(1 + 5.4545s + 2.2727s^2): Delta2 = 25.2066 -> d1 = 5.0206 h  (dropping -2.2 gives 5 h)
freq-matched first order 20.45/(5.021s+1): max step gap 1.447 K

======== [H4] Thermostat in room 2: P vs PI, small changes around the operating point
P, Kp=500 W/K: L(0)=4.091, e_ss = 1/(1+L(0)) = 0.1964; poles [-1.2+0.8944j -1.2-0.8944j], wn=1.497/h, zeta=0.802; setpoint step: final=0.8036, peak=0.8154, OS=1.477, Tp=3.512, Ts=2.519, Tr1090=1.653
P, Kp=1100 W/K: L(0)=9.000, e_ss = 1/(1+L(0)) = 0.1000; poles [-1.2+1.7205j -1.2-1.7205j], wn=2.098/h, zeta=0.572; setpoint step: final=0.9, peak=1.001, OS=11.18, Tp=1.826, Ts=2.805, Tr1090=0.8527
  -> feedback makes the house overshoot even though the open-loop house cannot

PI cubic bound (added): 2.4*(0.44+b Kp) > b Ki  ->  Ki < 2933.3333333333335 W/(K h)
cold front -5 K, open loop (heater fixed): room 2 change after 24 h = -4.959 K, worst = -4.959 K, extra heater power at 24 h = 0 W, peak extra 0 W
cold front -5 K, P 1100: room 2 change after 24 h = -0.500 K, worst = -0.605 K, extra heater power at 24 h = 550 W, peak extra 666 W
cold front -5 K, PI 1100/200: room 2 change after 24 h = -0.007 K, worst = -0.581 K, extra heater power at 24 h = 611 W, peak extra 737 W
steady extra heat for -5 K outside, PI (bedroom held): 5 K/G2(0) = 5/(b/0.44) = 611 W
  PI (bedroom back on its set point): living room +1.00 K (6.00 K more above outdoors), bedroom +0.00 K (5.00 K more); extra leak = 55.56 W/K x (6.00 + 5.00) K = 611 W (living-room wall 333 W + bedroom wall 278 W) = (5 K - droop)/G2(0) = 611 W
  P 1100 (bedroom 0.5 K low): living room +0.40 K (5.40 K more above outdoors), bedroom -0.50 K (4.50 K more); extra leak = 55.56 W/K x (5.40 + 4.50) K = 550 W (living-room wall 300 W + bedroom wall 250 W) = (5 K - droop)/G2(0) = 550 W
  inner wall must carry the bedroom's extra leak: 55.56 x 5 = 278 W = 277.8 W/K x 1 K -> living room +1 K (6 K more above outdoors)
P droop prediction: 5 K x S(0) = 5/(1+9) = 0.5 K

======== [H5] Sensitivity: insulation 20 % worse (leak 0.2 -> 0.24 /h)
G2(0): 0.008182 -> 0.006696 K/W (-18.15 %): open loop the room loses 18.2 % of its rise
P (Kp=1100): T(0) 0.9000 -> 0.8805 = -2.17 %; first-order prediction S(0) x dG/G = 0.1 x -18.15 % = -1.82 %
PI: T(0) = 1 for any G(0) > 0 -> 0 % at steady state
P 1100: |S| peak 1.331 at 2.577 rad/h; |C| peak 0.959 at 1.233 rad/h; crossover 1.480 rad/h

======== [H6] Sensor error: thermostat reads 1 K high (sun on the sensor)

======== [H7] House controllability / observability (used in the CC dive)
heater room 1, sensor room 2: det Pc = 1.296e-05 (= b^2), det Po = -1.000 -> both fine
two equal heaters, one dial (B = [b, b]): AB = [-0.0007 -0.0007] parallel to B -> det Pc = -1.2e-21: the difference mode (-2.2) cannot be steered
sensor reads the average of the rooms: det Po = 0.0e+00: the difference mode is invisible

======== [S3] The passive suspension is a feedback loop (LOOP box)
